purpose: Local Docker functional check of the new Tech Info prefetch default (no env) and of the rollback via env, H2 harness 'default' policy (the image's own settings), time scale 1 (the 1.5 s budget is a code constant), S1, 6 cold requests every 6 s with a warm pair 1 s later, nCore-like Tech Info 2.0 s, no failures, seed 20261110; steady window = requests 2..5 (n = 4).
result: Default: tech_info_prefetch true; the warm request is served from the background-filled cache in ~11 ms with 4 enriched streams, 4 Tech Info calls per cold request. Env false: tech_info_prefetch false; the warm request waits the 1.5 s budget again with 0 enriched streams, 8 calls per cold request (as C0 in gsp06-v2 t20).
